retrievalLimitations: No current comprehensive official ruling for every card-specific dynamic cost expression was newly obtained.
No PTCG Live behavior or log is treated as rules authority.
No Japanese, Asian or community source is mixed into the international ruleset.
implementationLimits: Supports fixed live integer changes from audited Tool, Stadium and Special Energy passive programs, applied only to the printed COLORLESS part of an attack cost.
A reduction can never remove a typed requirement; an increase adds only COLORLESS requirement. All calculation is server-side and shared by affordability and declaration.
Card-specific dynamic calculations, alternative payment, named attack restrictions and unaudited real-card programs remain unsupported and reject rather than being guessed.
